info.name: Regkasse API
info.description: Critical Regkasse API requests generated from backend/swagger.json. POS uses /api/pos, /api/Auth, and /api/Receipts. Admin uses /api/admin and /api/Auth. Replace collection variables before sending. Do not store real passwords in this file.

item.name: Getting Started
item.description: Run these in order on a Development API. Login stores the JWT. The tenant header is the collection variable tenantSlug, sent as X-Tenant-Id. Health does not require a token.

request.description: clientApp is pos or admin. The test script writes jwt, refreshToken, tenantId, and tenantSlug.

Development resolves the mandant from X-Tenant-Id: {{tenantSlug}} (seeded demo slug: dev). Production api.regkasse.at ignores this header and uses the JWT tenant_id claim. Change the collection variable, then send this request.
Liveness of the API process. /api/health/live and /api/health/ready are the probe split.
Development skips CSRF. When Security:Csrf is enabled, send the saved csrfToken as X-XSRF-TOKEN on POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE. Login, refresh, and /api/health are exempt.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Shared /api/Auth surface used by POS and Admin. Login is repeated here so the folder stands alone.

request.description: Super Admin TOTP step after password. Development can bypass 2FA. Do not use a real backup code in this collection.

item.name: POS
item.description: Cashier API. POS clients call /api/pos/*, /api/Auth/*, and /api/Receipts/* only.

request.description: totalAmount is a client hint. The server recomputes catalog totals and rejects a mismatch. Idempotency-Key retries return the existing payment.
Full-receipt cancellation. stornoReason is the RKSV enum name (KundeStorniert, FalscherBetrag, TechnischerFehler, Anderes).
Tagesabschluss. A closed day blocks further payments until the next business day.

item.name: Admin
item.description: FA API under /api/admin/*. Mandanten-Admin is role Manager. Cross-tenant reads return 404.

request.description: role is the backend name (Cashier, Manager, SuperAdmin). The generated password is returned once.
Super Admin wizard. countryCode is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. vatRegime must be allowed for that country. AT_RKSV_STANDARD is the Austrian default.
Super Admin only. The issued JWT carries the target tenant_id and tenant_impersonation=true.
PDF reprint of the fiscal receipt. Save the response as a file.

item.name: Fiscal
item.description: TSE status and DEP / RKSV special receipts. These samples do not change signing rules. A forced Monatsbeleg is a past-month catch-up, not a normal sale.

request.description: Datenerfassungsprotokoll JSON for the selected register and period.
force=true creates a late Monatsbeleg for a past month. The response includes the new BelegNr.
